property_summary: For any nonzero newOwner address, calling transferOwnership(newOwner) by the current owner sets owner() to newOwner; the mutant that removes the nonzero check additionally allows setting owner to address(0) via transferOwnership, violating the rule that transferOwnership never sets owner to the zero address for nonzero inputs (and enabling owner==address(0) when newOwner==address(0)).
change_summary: Removed the require check that newOwner is not zero address, allowing transferOwnership to set owner to address(0) (renouncing) even when called via transferOwnership.
